annotations.title: Prepare a French legal notice on legalone.fr

description: Use this when the user wants LegalOne to prepare their legal notice: a change to an existing company (registered office transfer, change of manager or president, name, corporate purpose, share capital, duration, early dissolution, liquidation closure), from its SIREN and the facts of the decision; or the creation of a company (SAS, SASU, SARL, EURL, SCI and the other forms of which_legal_notice), from its articles of association, without SIREN. Creates a draft on legalone.fr and returns the notice text, what is left to complete and a link, valid 7 days, that opens the pre-filled form. `missing` lists what the form still requires: the draft is complete only when it is empty; otherwise tell the user what to add on the form (for instance the company's duration, from the articles of association, when the notice prints it). Each call creates a new draft: gather all the facts first; to add or correct a fact afterwards, call update_legal_notice_draft with the draftId and editToken returned here, rather than calling again. The user reviews, completes and pays on legalone.fr; nothing is published or paid here. Do not use for a sole trader, and do not send birth dates, nationalities or contact details. Home addresses are sent only for the officers of a company being created, as its notice publishes them; for a change, they are completed on legalone.fr.

capital.description: Creation: share capital in euros (fixed capital).

companyDurationYears.description: Company duration in years, as in the articles of association. Required for a creation, an extension of duration and a transfer to another registry (the notice prints it), otherwise optional: send it whenever the user knows it; when required and absent, it comes back in missing.

companyName.description: Creation: name of the company, as in the articles.

decisionBody.description: Body that took the decision: a general meeting; the partners or shareholders deciding collectively (meeting not specified or written consultation) or unanimously (act signed by all); the sole partner; the manager or the management (several managers); the president or the managing director (SAS, SA); the board of directors, the management board (directoire) or the supervisory board (SA, SCA). other: any other body, named in decisionBodyOther.

decisionBodyOther.description: Only when decisionBody is other (sent alone, it implies other): the body as the notice prints it after « Par décision », in French, starting with du, de la, de l' or des, e.g. « du comité de direction ».

decisionDate.description: Date of the meeting or decision (YYYY-MM-DD).

deedDate.description: Creation: date the articles of association were signed (YYYY-MM-DD).

deedType.description: Creation: form of the articles of association.

department.description: Publication department, used only when it cannot be read from the registered office (the notice is published where the office is).

formality.description: Formality, as returned by which_legal_notice: a change to an existing company, or a creation (sas, sasu, sarl, eurl, sci…).

initialCapital.description: Creation with a variable capital: initial capital in euros.

maximumCapital.description: Creation with a variable capital: maximum capital in euros.

meetingAdmissionClause.description: Creation of a share company (SAS, SA…): clause on admission to meetings and voting rights, as in the articles.

minimumCapital.description: Creation with a variable capital: minimum capital in euros.

newCapital.description: Share capital after the operation, in euros.

newPurpose.description: Corporate purpose as written in the decision.

newSeatCourt.description: Commercial court (greffe) of the new registered office, e.g. Nanterre; deduced when the department has one court.

newSeatStreet.description: New registered office: number and street.

notaryCity.description: Creation by notarial deed: city where the notary practises.

notaryName.description: Creation by notarial deed: name of the notary.

officerChange.description: appointment: a new officer without departure; replacement: one leaves, one arrives; departure: one leaves without replacement.

officers.description: Creation only: the officers and auditors the notice names, with a person's home address as the notice publishes it. Roles by formality: eurl/sarl/sc/sci/sccv/scm/scpi/scp/seleurl/selarl: manager; sasu/selas/selasu: president, chief_executive, deputy_chief_executive, auditor, substitute_auditor; sas/selafa: president, chief_executive, deputy_chief_executive, director, auditor, substitute_auditor; snc: manager, partner, co_manager, auditor, substitute_auditor; sa: president, chief_executive, deputy_chief_executive, director, management_board_member, auditor, substitute_auditor.

capital.description: Company holding the role: its share capital in euros.

companyName.description: Company holding the role: its name.

country.description: Person living outside France: country (then no postcode).

court.description: Company holding the role: its court of registration.

legalForm.description: Company holding the role: its legal form.

role.description: Role in the new company; the roles a formality accepts are listed in its description.

siren.description: Company holding the role: its SIREN (9 digits).

street.description: Person: home address (number and street), published by the notice. Company: address of its registered office.

type.description: person: a natural person; company: a company holding the role.

profession.description: Creation of a société d'exercice libéral (seleurl, selarl, selas, selasu, selafa), optional: profession practised, as in the articles, e.g. avocat. The notice prints it when given.

purpose.description: Creation: corporate purpose, as written in the articles.

representativeRole.description: Role of the legal representative named in the arrival notice.

seatComplement.description: Creation: registered office, building or floor (optional).

seatCourt.description: Creation: commercial court (greffe) of registration, e.g. Bobigny; deduced when the department has one court.

seatStreet.description: Creation: registered office, number and street.

shareTransferClause.description: Creation of a share company (SAS, SA…): clause on the transfer of shares, as in the articles.

siren.description: SIREN of the existing company (9 digits, spaces allowed). Required for a change; none for a creation.
